service.description: Receive a customer return shipment's lines: for each return item the quantity that arrived, accepted and rejected (quarantined) alike, received as stock (AssetReceipt) on the item's shipment source, added to ReturnItem.receivedQuantity. It never changes returnQuantity and processes no response, so a second box, or units rejected at the dock, can still be received and credited against the authorization by settle#Return. An item reaches ReturnReceived (ReturnManResp for a manual response) when its received quantity equals the authorized quantity, the return when every item is handled, and the shipment ShipDelivered when every source is handled. Refuses more than was authorized (RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_RETURN), an item not on the shipment, a closed item, a shipment that is not a customer return, and an organization that does not settle returns separately (RETURN_SETTLEMENT_OFF: Mantle receives its returns when the shipment is delivered). Needs STOCK_RECEIVE in the receiving organization.

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: Defaults to the shipment's destination facility.

parameter.name: itemList
parameter.description: Maps of returnId, returnItemSeqId, quantityAccepted, quantityRejected, rejectionReasonEnumId and, for the stock, statusId (default AstOnHold) and lotNumber.

parameter.name: receivedItems
parameter.description: Each item's returnId, returnItemSeqId, receivedQuantity, statusId and assetReceiptIds.

service.description: Move an asset, or part of it, to a location or a container of its own facility, through mantle.product.AssetServices.move#Asset: a part becomes its own asset there, the whole asset moves, and the reservations it carries move with it as Mantle moves them. A retry with the same operation key and request answers the first move (alreadyApplied); a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. Refuses without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); an asset outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), equipment (NOT_STOCK), nothing on hand (NO_STOCK), a quantity above on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND); another facility (OTHER_FACILITY: a transfer); a closed or missing location (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE); the place it is already (SAME_LOCATION); a container holding another owner's stock (CONTAINER_OWNER); a quarantined asset to a location whose type would release it, or any status change with no status flow transition (HELD_STOCK, F8). Reservations carried onto stock that is not available are checked again, so the order is re-reserved on available stock (F38). Expired and near-expiry stock moves with a warning naming its date. workEffortId is the production run a staging move is for, kept in the answer.

parameter.name: operationKey
parameter.description: The client's operation id (a scan id or a form's operation id), at most 200 characters; scoped by user and operation type.

parameter.name: quantity
parameter.description: Empty moves the whole asset.

parameter.name: toContainerId
parameter.description: A container of the facility: the asset moves into it, at its location.

parameter.name: toFacilityId
parameter.description: Given only to refuse another facility.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode MOVED, assetId, toAssetId, productId, quantity, facilityId, fromLocationSeqId, toLocationSeqId, toContainerId, fromStatusId, statusId, reservationsChecked, warnings (code, expiryDate, message), reason, workEffortId, and the operation fields.

set.from: posting.destination(userScope, asset.facilityId, {toLocationSeqId: toLocationSeqId, toContainerId: toContainerId, toFacilityId: toFacilityId, ownerPartyId: asset.ownerPartyId})

return.message: SAME_LOCATION: Asset ${assetId} is already at ${target.locationSeqId}

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, home.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.product.asset.Asset', toAssetId, {resultCode: 'MOVED', assetId: assetId, toAssetId: toAssetId, productId: asset.productId, quantity: String(moveQuantity), facilityId: asset.facilityId, fromLocationSeqId: asset.locationSeqId || null, toLocationSeqId: target.locationSeqId, toContainerId: target.containerId, fromStatusId: asset.statusId, statusId: statusAfter, reservationsChecked: reservationsChecked, warnings: warnings, reason: reason || null, workEffortId: workEffortId || null})

service.description: Move each of the given whole assets to one location or container: each asset is its own move#Stock, in its own transaction, under the operation "operationKey/assetId", so an asset that cannot move is named with its reason and the others move. The batch is an operation too (StockRelocate, its request the assets and the destination): a retry answers the first batch's results, and a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. Refuses the whole batch only without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED) or with no asset.

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Per asset: key (the assetId), ok, resultCode and result (move#Stock's answer), or reasonCode and message.

return.message: ASSETS_REQUIRED: Choose the assets to move

service.description: Move a container with all its contents to another location of its facility, all or nothing: every content asset is checked first (a quarantined one the new location would release refuses the whole move, HELD_STOCK, naming it), then the container's location changes and each asset moves with it through move#Asset, which gives it the location type's status; reservations carried onto stock that is not available are checked again (F38). Refuses as move#Stock: STOCK_MOVE, the user's facilities, another facility (OTHER_FACILITY), a closed location, the place it is (SAME_LOCATION). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode MOVED, containerId, facilityId, fromLocationSeqId, toLocationSeqId, assets (assetId, productId, quantity, fromStatusId, statusId), warnings, reason.

service.description: Repair the reservations at a facility that WarehousePolicyServices.preview#FacilityReservations named, as previewed: refuses when they changed since (PREVIEW_CHANGED: preview again). A reservation on stock no longer available, for another facility's order or on a pool the order does not qualify for is checked again (check#AssetReservationValid: removed and re-reserved). For a not-available reservation of a product with available stock there, the product's not-available reservations at the facility, the previewed ones among them, are moved onto that stock (reserve#IncreasedAsset, which takes them in its own order), and each previewed one is reported as repaired or as still not available. Each in its own transaction: one that fails is named and the others go on. Requires STOCK_POLICY_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a facility of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode REPAIRED, facilityId, productId, rows (per reservation: assetReservationId, orderId, orderItemSeqId, reasonCode, ok, message), repairedCount, failedCount.

return.message: PREVIEW_CHANGED: The reservations changed since the check; check them again

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, home.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.facility.Facility', facilityId, {resultCode: 'REPAIRED', facilityId: facilityId, productId: productId || null, rows: rows, repairedCount: rows.filter(row => row.ok).length, failedCount: rows.filter(row => !row.ok).length})

parameter.description: One asset: the bucket is that asset alone.

parameter.name: locationScope
parameter.description: With no location: none (the default) or any.

parameter.name: lotScope
parameter.description: With no lot: none (the default) or any.

parameter.name: mode
parameter.description: count: quantity is what is there (zero is a count); delta: quantity is the change.

parameter.name: physicalInventoryDate
parameter.description: The effective date, now when empty; a backdated adjustment reads the bucket as of then.

service.description: The before and after of an adjustment of an exact stock bucket, read only: the quantity on hand as of the effective date, the change, the result, the assets it reaches and previewFingerprint, which adjust#Stock compares so a movement after the preview refuses the posting. The value of the change, at the cost of the assets it reaches (Mantle's order: oldest received first), only for a user with ACCOUNTING_VIEW (cost is not read otherwise), unavailable when one of them has no cost. Refuses without STOCK_ADJUST (PERMISSION_DENIED), a facility outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a future date (DATE_INVALID), a count below zero or a zero change (QUANTITY_INVALID), a reduction beyond what was on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND) and a bucket of more than 500 assets (BUCKET_TOO_LARGE).

parameter.name: preview

service.description: Post an adjustment of an exact stock bucket as previewed: a count through mantle.product.AssetServices.record#PhysicalInventoryQuantity, a change (or any adjustment of one asset) through record#PhysicalInventoryChange, on a PhysicalInventory of its own with the reason, so the variance posts by its reason (post#PhysicalInventoryVariance). A retry with the same operation key and request answers the first adjustment (alreadyApplied); a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. The bucket's assets are locked and read again: a movement since the preview is PREVIEW_CHANGED (preview again). Refuses without STOCK_ADJUST (PERMISSION_DENIED), without a variance reason (REASON_REQUIRED, REASON_INVALID), a facility outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a closed fiscal period of the effective date for an organization it posts to (PERIOD_CLOSED), and as preview#StockAdjustment. A count that matches answers NO_CHANGE and posts nothing.

PREVIEW_CHANGED: The stock changed since the preview; preview again

service.description: Scrap free stock (WH-SCRAP): an asset, or part of it, perhaps moved first to a morgue location of its facility (move#Asset; the location type's status, AstMorgue), then taken out of stock through record#PhysicalInventoryChange with a scrap reason (InVrScrap or InVrExpired, enumCode scrap) or InVrDamaged, on a PhysicalInventory of its own marked scrapIndicator Y, one per operation (F5), which Counts leave out. The variance posts by its reason (post#PhysicalInventoryVariance: the organization's VarianceReasonGlAccount, then the asset type's scrapGlAccountId). A retry with the same operation key answers the first scrap, so it posts once. Refuses without STOCK_ADJUST (PERMISSION_DENIED); as move#Stock: the user's facilities, equipment, nothing on hand, a quantity above on hand; a reason that is not a scrap reason (REASON_INVALID); quarantined stock (HELD_STOCK: its inspection's disposition scraps it); reserved stock beyond what is free (RESERVED_STOCK); a location that is not a morgue (LOCATION_NOT_MORGUE), closed or missing; a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED).

parameter.description: Empty scraps all of it.

parameter.name: toLocationSeqId

return.message: REASON_INVALID: Scrap with a scrap, expired or damaged reason
HELD_STOCK: Asset ${assetId} is quarantined; its inspection's disposition scraps it

set.from: String(free.toNumber()) + ' of asset ' + assetId + ' is free; ' + String(reserved.toNumber()) + ' is reserved'

return.message: RESERVED_STOCK: Only ${freeText}

service.description: Correct a lot's metadata (WH-EXPIRY corrections): its number, manufacturer, manufactured date and expiration date, each change kept in the audit log with its old and new values, the reason and the user. Only the fields given change (clearExpirationDate removes the expiry). An asset of the lot whose expected end of life is the old expiration follows it. Extending the expiry (a later date, or none) needs LOT_EXPIRY_EXTEND and releases no quarantine; any other change, an earlier expiry among them, needs STOCK_ADJUST. A retry with the same operation key answers the first correction. Refuses without either permission (PERMISSION_DENIED), without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED), a lot whose stock is not in the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or is also another organization's (LOT_SHARED), nothing changed (NO_CHANGE), and a number the manufacturer already has (LOT_EXISTS).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode CORRECTED, lotId, changes (field, oldValue, newValue), expiryExtended, assetIds (the assets whose expected end of life followed), changeReason, changedByUserId, and the operation fields.

return.message: REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for the correction
NO_CHANGE: Nothing to correct on lot ${lotId}
PERMISSION_DENIED: Extending an expiry needs LOT_EXPIRY_EXTEND
PERMISSION_DENIED: Correcting a lot needs STOCK_ADJUST
LOT_EXISTS: The manufacturer already has lot ${sameNumber[0].lotNumber}

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, scoped.owners[0] || null, 'mantle.product.asset.Lot', lotId, {resultCode: 'CORRECTED', lotId: lotId, changes: changes, expiryExtended: expiryExtended, assetIds: assetIds, changeReason: String(changeReason).trim(), changedByUserId: ec.user.userId})

service.description: Unpack or repack stock (design-warehouse Repack): the source asset's quantity is issued (issue#AssetToWorkEffort) to a new organization-owned WepAssembling WorkEffort, which posts it to WIP, and the target product is received (receive#Asset) from it with the source's lot, expiry and owner and the acquireCost of the issued cost divided by the target quantity, which relieves WIP: the two postings net to zero through AssetIssuanceGlPost and AssetReceiptGlPost. The receipt links its source issuance (AssetReceipt.sourceAssetIssuanceId) and keeps the entered source quantity and the conversion factor. Both movements post or neither does. The conversion is Products' packaging (resolve#ScannedProduct): unpack a pack into its contents, or repack contents into whole packs. A retry with the same operation key answers the first repack. Refuses without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); as move#Stock: the user's facilities, the stock and quantity, a closed or missing location, held stock or a status change with no flow (HELD_STOCK); stock that is not free to issue (RESERVED_STOCK); no packaging between the products (PACK_UNDEFINED); not whole packs (QUANTITY_NOT_WHOLE_PACKS); a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED).

parameter.description: Empty unpacks into the pack's contents.

parameter.name: toLocationSeqId
parameter.description: Where the target is received; the source's location when empty.

parameter.description: resultCode REPACKED, direction, assetId, sourceProductId, quantity, targetProductId, targetQuantity, factor, toAssetId, lotId, facilityId, locationSeqId, statusId, workEffortId, assetIssuanceId, assetReceiptId, reason, warnings, and the operation fields.
